content:
Date: Thursday, June 25, 2026

Selected Approach:
- Per-component RxJS pipe — a Subject per search, debounceTime(300) → distinctUntilChanged → switchMap, mirroring the app's existing pattern

Approved implementation approach:
In each of the three components add a searchInput$ = new Subject<string>(); the (ionInput)/(input) handler calls .next(value) instead of invoking the async search directly. Subscribe once in ngOnInit with debounceTime(300) → distinctUntilChanged() → switchMap(term => httpCall) → takeUntil(destroy$), moving result assignment into the subscription. For the two stock searches, fold the equity + ETF /alpaca/assets calls into a single forkJoin inside the switchMap so both are cancelled together. Catch errors inside the inner observable so the stream survives. This is the same idiom already in app.component.ts and the one FRED-114 specified for the referral validator.

Andrew's Answers:
Q: Is the in-memory stockselection searchbar in scope? It filters a pre-loaded asset list client-side (no network request), so switchMap cancellation doesn't apply. The story says "API searches," and this isn't one — my recommendation is to leave it as-is (at most a tiny render-only debounce if the 7,000-asset filter ever feels laggy, but no switchMap). Optional
  A (Andrew wrote): stockselection should be a search thru alpacas assets endpoint and not a client side filter. update the stock selection to only search as a stock selection so this way it’s definitely in scope because that was what the expectation of what the code should do and was already doing for when this story was written. stock selection should only be a backend search and no frontend filtering
Q: Confirm the search set and debounce window. I'm treating the complete set of network searches as exactly three — lump-sum stock search, portfolio-customize stock search, and the my-profile referral validator — with a 300ms debounce to match the existing app.component.ts value. Flag here if you know of another as-you-type backend search I should fold in, or want a snappier window. Optional
  A (Andrew wrote): my profile referral validator is not applicable for these changes. the only searches that should get the updates in this story are lump-sum stock search and portfolio-customize stock search

Proceed with implementation.
